CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFWDDX

WDDX (Web Distributed Data Exchange) is an XML format for passing data between programs, servers and browsers. CFWDDX serializes any CFML value (strings, numbers, dates, arrays, structures, queries) into a WDDX packet, turns a packet back into CFML, or writes JavaScript that rebuilds the data in the browser.

Category

Data interchange

Syntax

<CFWDDX ACTION="action"
    INPUT="inputdata"
    OUTPUT="resultvariable"
    TOPLEVELVARIABLE="toplevelvariablenameforjavascript"
    USETIMEZONEINFO="Yes/No">

Attributes

ACTION
Required. CFML2WDDX (CFML to packet), WDDX2CFML (packet to CFML), CFML2JS (CFML to JavaScript) or WDDX2JS (packet to JavaScript).
INPUT
Required. The value to convert, usually written as an expression such as #MyStruct#.
OUTPUT
Optional. Variable that receives the result. Without it, the result is written into the page.
TOPLEVELVARIABLE
Required for CFML2JS and WDDX2JS. Name of the JavaScript variable to create.
USETIMEZONEINFO
Optional, default "Yes". Whether serialized dates carry the server's time-zone offset.

Usage

Packets are plain text, so you can store them in a database column, a client variable or a hidden form field, or send them to another server with CFHTTP. A malformed packet throws an Application exception ("WDDX packet parse error"). IsWDDX tells you whether a string is a valid packet before you deserialize it.

The JavaScript produced by CFML2JS and WDDX2JS creates Object, Array and Date values. Structure keys come out in lower case. Put it inside a <SCRIPT> block to give your client-side code the same data as the server.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Order = StructNew()>
<CFSET Order.Customer = "Pat Kowal">
<CFSET Order.Placed = CreateDateTime(1999, 12, 31, 23, 59, 0)>
<CFSET Order.Items = ListToArray("Modem,Mouse pad,Y2K patch disk")>

<CFWDDX ACTION="CFML2WDDX" INPUT="#Order#" OUTPUT="Packet">
<CFWDDX ACTION="WDDX2CFML" INPUT="#Packet#" OUTPUT="Copy">
<CFWDDX ACTION="CFML2JS" INPUT="#Order#" TOPLEVELVARIABLE="order" OUTPUT="Script">

<CFOUTPUT>
<P><B>The WDDX packet</B> (#Len(Packet)# characters, IsWDDX: #IsWDDX(Packet)#):</P>
<PRE>#HTMLEditFormat(Replace(Packet, "><", ">#Chr(10)#<", "ALL"))#</PRE>
<P><B>Back in CFML:</B></P>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TD>Customer</TD><TD>#Copy.Customer#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Placed</TD><TD>#DateFormat(Copy.Placed, "mmmm d, yyyy")# #TimeFormat(Copy.Placed, "h:mm tt")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Items</TD><TD>#ArrayToList(Copy.Items, ", ")#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
<P><B>As JavaScript:</B></P>
<PRE>#HTMLEditFormat(Script)#</PRE>
</CFOUTPUT>
